stem_book: Find the velocity of the hanging block if the velocities of the free ends of the rope are as indicated in the figure (the rope passes over two fixed pulleys and under the movable pulley carrying the block; its left free end is pulled horizontally away at 2 m/s and its right free end moves down at 1 m/s). (a) (5/2) m/s ↑ (b) (5/2) m/s ↓ (c) (1/2) m/s ↑ (d) (3/2) m/s ↑
work: Both ends pull rope out of the pulley loop: v_block = (2 + 1)/2 = 3/2 m/s upward
